CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBe.en:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBe.fr: En utilisant de la bonne POUDRE\nBAIE, je peux préparer\ptoutes sortes de médicaments.\pDis-moi, tu t'y connais un peu en\nBAIES ?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughB.en: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughB.fr: Hmm. Tu n'as pas assez de POUDRE\nBAIE.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesA.en:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesA.fr:
Il y a du nouveau au premier étage
des CENTRES POKéMON.\pIls ont ajouté une machine pour
broyer les BAIES dans\pla SALLE LINK DIRECT. C'est là que
tu interviens.\pPourrais-tu aller faire de la
POUDRE pour moi en\putilisant cette machine ?\pN'oublie pas, la machine se trouve
dans la SALLE LINK DIRECT.\pJe ferai une préparation juste pour
toi si tu arrives à broyer\pdes BAIES et à me ramener la
POUDRE.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThin.en: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThin.fr: Parfait ! Alors j'ai juste ce qu'il\nte faut.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtB.en: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtB.fr: M'as-tu amené de la POUDRE BAIE ?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAga.en: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLike.en: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLike.fr: Reviens me voir si tu veux encore\néchanger de la POUDRE BAIE.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInA.en: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInA.fr: Les BAIES t'intéressent pas ?\pA ton âge, il faut s'intéresser à\nplein de choses.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryP.en: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryP.fr: Cette POUDRE BAIE a l'air bonne. Ça\nfera de bons médicaments.\pTu veux échanger ce qui te reste\ncontre autre chose ?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNo.en: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNo.fr: Pourquoi me mentir ?\pT'as combien de BAIES ?\nPas une seule !

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBe.en: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBe.fr: Je vais te donner 1 {STR_VAR_1} contre\nla POUDRE BAIE.

CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWha.en: With what would you like to \nexchange it?
